annotations.title: Irish VRT and NOx levy estimate

description: Use to estimate Vehicle Registration Tax and the NOx levy for a vehicle registered in Ireland, from its taxable value (OMSP), CO2 emissions and fuel type. Estimate only; verify against Revenue.ie. Use import_calculator instead for a full UK-to-Ireland landed-cost and margin estimate. Free (limited to 10 calls per day per IP).

fuel_type.description: Fuel type, e.g. Petrol, Diesel, Electric, Petrol Hybrid, Petrol Plug-in Hybrid.

price_eur.description: Open market selling price (OMSP) in EUR.
